features.name: Voice of Authority
features.desc: When you cast a spell of level 1+ on an ally, that ally can use its Reaction to make one weapon attack.

features.name: Embodiment of the Law
features.desc: You can cast Enchantment spells of level 1+ as a Bonus Action (once per turn).

features.name: Order's Wrath
features.desc: A target hit by your Divine Smite takes an extra 2d8 Psychic damage.
